THE INTERNATIONALLY FAMOUS
TW A Douglas Luxury Airliner
is revolutionizing the art of flying. Discriminating air travelers everywhere are demand-
ing TWA speed and security.
Commuting between California and New York which would have sounded fantastic
until recently, is now not only a possibility but an everyday occurrence, made possible
by TWA's overnight coast to coast service.
Wide-awake business and professional men whose time is valuable, women who enjoy
the luxury and simplicity of air travel, and vacationists who demand the most of their
holiday period, are taking advantage of this popular mode of travel in greatly increasing
You, too, will enjoy traveling on TWA, "The Lindbergh Line."
A FEW OUTSTANDING REASONS
for TWA SUPREMACY
TWA Douglas Luxury Airliners, operating on
regular overnight service between the Atlantic
and Pacific coasts, provide the fastest trans-
continental service.
TWA is the only airline in the world equipped
with syro pilot and automatic stabilizers. Only
on TWA can you enjoy the luxury, speed and
dependability of a mighty fleet of Douglas Air-
liners all the way from coast to coast.
The TWA route was personally selected by
Colonel Lindbergh as being best adapted for
regular transcontinental service, and the excep-
tional performance record has amply vindicated
his judgment.
Only Douglas Airliners have the comforts of
steam heated cabins, maintaining by thermostatic
control a constant cabin temperature of 70
degrees.
The unusually quiet cabins of the TWA Luxury
Airliners permit conversation to be carried on
in an ordinary tone of voice.
Vibration and
engine noise have been practically eliminated.
Two 700 horsepower Wright Cyclone engines
provide more than sufficient reserve power to
enable the plane to not only fly, but to take-off
fully loaded on only one engine.
TWA's SKY CHIEF, the criterion for all air
travel, is truly a limited service, making only four
stops between California and New York.

OST LOUIS

OSAN DIEGO
TWA has been referred to as "The Line of the
Presidents."
The passenger list on the SKY
CHIEF resembles a page from Who's Who,
numbering business and social
leaders from all walks of life.

COLUMBUS
INDIANAPOLIS
